decisions.reason: As a low-risk extension of the firm's wood-floor care system, it fits the announced full-service offer and there is no clear evidence yet that would overcome management's tendency to continue a recently introduced product.

The maintenance oil is closely tied to the installed base of wooden floors, so sunk commercial effort and the logic of offering complete maintenance solutions make management likely to persist with it.
Although care products are easier to withdraw than core floors, this one still supports the firm's established oiled-floor segment and recent launch commitment makes near-term withdrawal unlikely.
The moisture-protection underlay strengthens the firm's system-selling approach around flooring installation, and its strategic fit and recent introduction favor continued support rather than exit.
The high-density underlay foam complements the core flooring business and helps present a complete installation package, so management would likely keep backing it absent strong negative signals.

An oak parquet floor is closest to the firm's core business, likely carries the highest investment and visibility, and therefore management is especially prone to continue it under an escalation-of-commitment logic.
